title: PPL + Circuit
author: Michael Harris
desc: Unleash your potential with the PPL + Circuit program, designed for those ready to elevate their strength and muscle gains in just one week. This dynamic four-day routine combines Push, Pull, and Legs with high-intensity circuits to maximize your workout efficiency. Each session lasts around 60 minutes, featuring exercises like kettlebell swings and goblet squats to challenge your entire body. Perfect for intermediate lifters, this program requires a full gym setup and will push you to new heights with every rep!
